notes.title: [Hot Fix] Soryu Kai patch is out
notes.content:
Hello everyone.
You might notice that there's an update of Project Nimbus coming out today.

This is just a hotfix of the update I released yesterday. I received some bug reports that the moving up keyboard input doesn't work after the player has done some keyboard mapping adjustment so I've taken a look.

It appears that the bug just simply caused by a typo referencing to moving up input in the source code. To explain it simply, I mistype it as 'MoveUp' instead of 'GoUp' in the key setting section while the rest of the source code that use 'GoUp'. Look like this bug was there for a while but we've not detected that until yesterday. Thank you for reporting this in!

Gentlemen, this is why you shall not do the coding when you need to sleep. One typo in the >120,000 lines of code and the game is broken.

I'm glad we've fixed this.
Pawee

notes.title: New update: Your playing progress is saved
notes.content:
Hello everyone, the new build codename [b]'Soryu' [/b]is now online.

What's the big thing about this update? The game now saves your playing progress. You can continue playing from the part you left last time by simply pressing the 'continue' button.

I choose to do this the same way as online streaming websites. We save your playing progress. But you are still able to access any missions you want from the missions select menu. I don't know if I can explain my idea very well, I believe you guys shall be able to access any part of the game you want the same way that you can do it with movies since you've brought it. You own all of that.

And we prevent you from being spoiled (if you don't want) by having a very convenient way to start a new game or continue your playing progress by simply pressing the 'continue' or 'new game' on the menu without having to enter the missions select menu.

Hope you guys like that.

There's another small thing that I've adjusted. I've removed the 'mouse cursor movement smoothing' things from the menu. So the cursor will move more sharply, more responsive to your control. I guess you guys like it more this way.

Oh, there's a new ace pilots boss squadron appearing in the later part of Mission 10.  Meet "Karma" squadron, lead by USAF's ace pilot Michael "Melwin" Lansfeld in his customized M5 Viper. They'll come to assist the Black Knight squadron fighting against you but only in the 'PREPARE TO DIE' (hard) difficulty.

That's it for today's update.
Thank you very much for playing Project Nimbus.
Pawee Pakamekanon

Project Nimbus : Code Mirai is being developed by our Japanese partner, GameTomo who has invested their monetary resource, time and technical expertise to make this version a reality. GamecrafterTeam is acting as a consultant and quality assurance to make sure that the PS4 version stays true to Project Nimbus experience as much as possible. 

The decision whether to port the PS4 version to PC or not is still being discussed at this point. We have dedicated our effort into finishing this game but having said that, Gamecrafterteam will continue to work on additional contents post release. Taking advantage of the upgradability of the PC platform, we have plans to add more features into Project Nimbus well into the future."
...
So, that's the joint annoucement from 3 companies: KISS-ltd, GameTomo and GameCrafterTeam
--------------------------

So in short, I'm speaking to you that
- All of the money from PC players shall and always be used for PC players only.
- We're working on improving the graphic of the game and we vow to make the PC version of Project Nimbus look the best and modern, like any game released in 2017 shall be.
- We're adding content to Project Nimbus and we have the development plan for that.

---

notes.title: A little bit about fanworks, especially fanmade game.
notes.content:
Hello,

In addition to our game’s [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/257030/announcements/detail/834663798970953047]fanwork policy[/url], I think it would be good if we made it more clear in the case of fan games (doujin games).

I’ll keep this short and informative:

1. If you don’t sell your fan game, you can do whatever you want to do. You have 100% freedom.

2. If you are going to sell your game just don’t use the extracted model files from Project Nimbus in your work.

3. Fan-made (doujin) game’s stories are non-canon.

4. Project Nimbus IP is ours. Your creation is yours. If anyone steals your work and says that it’s a fan-made thing tell them that the creator of Project Nimbus stands by your side. You have our permission to do fan-made games and art with your own creations.

We are very excited and glad that our work can inspire other creators. If you want to do fanworks of our game, we’re very glad and encouraging you to do this. It’s just if you want to make a commercial game, please don’t use model files extracted from Project Nimbus. If you make your own art and models in your fan-made game you can sell it.

Pawee

notes.title: New update "Kirishima" ! Mission 18 - "Yamato Fortress" is here!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we haven't post update for quite some times right?

Today we have new patch, code name "Kirishima" containing Mission 18 and A LOT of game system's improvment.

Let's start with Mission 18: Yamato Fortress.

---

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission18release5][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/M18_release_banner.png[/img][/url]

Greetings, pilot! We are back again with a new mission for you.

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission18release3][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Capture_4.PNG[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission18release8][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Screencap_003.png[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission18release6][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Screencap_001.png[/img][/url]

Yamato Fortress is CFN continental defense network located in Okinawa, an array of gigantic anti-air cannons more than capable of wiping any attacking fleet. Destorying it is a daunting if not impossible task for the UCN if they are to circumvent the final obstacle and drive the CFN off Pacific region.

But with Lt.Yuliana and her shiny new ZX-08 Budushcheye, they just might.

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission18release11][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Screencap_cutscene_002.png[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission18release12][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Screencap_cutscene_003.png[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission18release13][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Screencap_cutscene_004.png[/img][/url]

In this build we also came around to include many audio logs for Mission 1 to 9. After you see this, we recommend you to check the older missions out and immerse yourself in Project Nimbus' universe. 

Several important gameplay changes have been made, most important of which is the removal of F.E.S. system. Now, you have to manually keep the target in your vision to stay locked on. We believe that by removing automated target tracking, the game will be more engaging and challenging for players. To compensate, gamepad users will have the rotation speed (on right analog stick by default) increased 3 times faster, allowing you to easily get the bead on faster enemies.

There is also a damage cap put into place, to prevent sudden death when your BattleFrame takes damage faster than the player can handle.

[url=http://www.indiedb.com/games/projectnimbus/images/mission18release1][img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/21/20285/thumb_620x2000/Capture_2.PNG[/img][/url]

We will conclude this news with a complete list of changes for this build. Like always, play the game and let us know what you think in Steam Discussion page or Facebook page! We are always all ears!

The codename for this update is "Kirishima". Check in the main menu to see if you're running latest version of the game.

----

Change list:
- Added MIssion 18 "Yamato Fortress"
- F.E.S. system is removed from the game. Gamepad users will have look sensitivity increased by three times to compensate.
- Added "Damage Delta" system; to prevent sudden death when player's BattleFrame takes damage faster than player can handle.
- Added low hull integrity (low hitpoints) warning, along with better damage feedback visual.
- AI-controlled IFV will now be destroyed if it hits water.
- M1 Guardian - Micromissile ammo capacity is increased from 2 to 3.
- Black Knights Squadron (Mission 10 - For the Fatherland) was nerfed to make the mission more playable.
- Mission 8 (Fragile Peace) has been adjusted; the downtime in between enemy waves has been reduced.
- Fixed audio errors in Mission 7 (Against All Enemy).
- Fixed errors with Multi-locker that occur when the game is hitting low FPS.
- Fixed Particle Cannon weapon not working properly on AI-controlled UCN Cruisers. They should be comparable to the CFN equivalent now.
- Fixed AI-controlled S47 Berkut not firing the Autoshotgun at hostile targets. The usage of their automatic shotgun was not as effective as it should be until now.
- Fixed text characters displaying as [] in subtitles.
- Fixed the bug where locked-on enemy shows up in mini-display with low texture resolution instead of defined settings.

notes.title: Minor update: Shimakaze Kai build
notes.content:

Thank you very much for your support.
Pawee Pakamekanon

notes.content:
Hello, the new patch code name 'Shiratsuyu Kai Ni' is now online for PC.

notes.title: New mission! Mission 9: Thermopylae, you're going to fight in space this time!
notes.content:
Ok, the new build (code name: Shigure Kai Ni) is now online. Here's the list of what's new in this update.

- New campaign mission, mission 9: Thermopylae is now available for play. This time, you're a USAF pilot call sign Skull-1 piloting brand new transformable Battle Frame M5 Viper guarding Ecuador orbital elevator from well… a Kirov class destroyer, 2 St.Petersburg class corvette, about a hundred of fighter and Battle Frame.

- It’s 4 M5 (and 4 M3) against entire Spetsnaz strike force. And the Russian are very angry this time. Did I mention you that there are some S47 Berkut and Gripen in enemy’s strike force? Yes, today you’re dogfighting these powerful machines. So… good luck out there. Hope you survive the battle.

- You guys remember the Salustaris ship you fought somewhere in the first episode right? Imagine another ship in that class, with more modern weaponry and much, much more turret and armor. The Kirov class destroyer have ability to track and intercept multiple incoming missiles and target at once. Have fun taking it out with mass produced frame, not prototype one.

- We’ve implement M5 Viper A.I., in 9th mission, you’ll see them as your 3 wingmen. There’ll really stick with you and provide you, their squadron leader, cover. M5 Viper’s A.I. is by far, the most advance and sophisticate Battle Frame A.I. we’ve ever design.

- Yes, like the S47 and Gripen, expect to fight them as enemy in next missions.

- New ‘Battle Camera’ system that will zoom in to locked target and display the image in small window near the target’s position on your screen. With this system, you’ll be able to see your distance target. No more dogfighting fast moving green dots on the screen. Now you actually see your opponent every movement and destruction. You’re going to love this. :D

- We adjust Rise Mirai level’s level design a little bit to make it’s less likely for player to get stuck in Mirai’s starting up hangar. And we improve that scene’s lighting a little bit.

- This might be minor things for some of you guys, but all missions now have subtitle. So it shall be easier to understand what’s going on.

- Hope you guys enjoy this update! And… well, hope you guys survive the ‘Thermopylae’ mission.

notes.title: The game keep getting better right? New update: Fubuki Kai Ni, is now online!
notes.content:
The new update build, code name 'Fubuki Kai Ni' is now online. Here's the list of what we've done in this update.

- Each type of weapon now using different cross hair. So you can know what kind of weapon you're using without having to glance at the bottom right of the screen.

- A.I.'s AF-18 jet fighters are now faster and utilize better weaponry. They shall not be outperformed by drones now.

- Missile trail effect improved. Display glitch at the end of its trail removed. And it now look softer and bigger now.

notes.title: Fubuki update has been uploaded today
notes.content:
Well, some of you guys might have noticed this minutes ago. :D We've new update coming out today, code name: Fubuki.

What's new in Fubuki build
- When using sword while a target is locked, your frame will boost to the locked target. Making slashing the target much easier. This system work on Mirai and M5 (both in Frame mode and Fighter mode). It's now possible and easier to kill with sword even when using M5 in flight mode. < Please try this system, it's fun to use.
- Playing M5 flight mode with controller now have comparable manueverbility to mouse.
- M5 transfrom button on Controller set to button X
- When Machine gun/Cannon/Rail gun bullet hit target, you will be notify by on HUD message

Tweak
- Gripen's missile has a little bit lower tracking ability
- Gripen's generator is a little bit weaker
- M5's fighter mode speed is now faster
- M5's boost energy consumption rate is lower
- M5's generator is now a little bit better
- Later part of Justitia Creo balance adjusted, now more possible to beat on hard difficulty. More allied M1 spawned at the beginning of that part.

Bug fix
- Strange glitch (no mech) in Survival mode happened when intended to play as Mirai Full Armor (but didn't click on the frame name) fixed.
- Fix Jennifer Carera M3 custom flare reloading glitch
- A.I. M3 now avoid firing missile in close space so they'll not hit themselves.
- Allied M3 in the later part of Justitia Creo mission now less likely to be stuck in spawn hangar
- Patriot level last ten seconds countdown sometime speak Thai instead of English line, fix.
